title: kate-fileio: treat a trailing CR as an ending
summary: to_wire_form does not add another ending when the text already ends in CR or LF. A text with no ending still gains one. The test goes in the existing encode tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: encode.rs has one test module named tests.  Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Edit only the ensure_trailing_newline check in to_wire_form. Replace it with this one if. Do not nest if inside if. if opts.ensure_trailing_newline && !s.is_empty() && !s.ends_with('\n') && !s.ends_with('\r') { out.push_str(opts.line_ending.as_str()); } Do not touch the CR LF skip loop, encode, write_bom, or encode_utf16_bytes. The test a_trailing_cr_counts_as_an_ending calls encode. UTF-8, bom false, line ending Lf, ensure_trailing_newline true. The text a then CR returns the bytes a, CR. The text a returns the bytes a, LF. The text a then LF returns the bytes a, LF. The text a, CR, LF with line ending CrLf and ensure_trailing_newline true returns the bytes a, CR, LF. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: encode::tests::a_trailing_cr_counts_as_an_ending
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. a then CR with ensure_trailing_newline and an LF ending becomes a, CR, LF. After the change it stays a, CR. The text a still gains an LF. The text a then LF stays a, LF. a, CR, LF with a CR LF ending stays one CR LF pair.
